title: Python code and simulation data for aging-aware predictive thermal management of lithium-ion battery packs under tropical fast charging
description: Python code, simulation outputs, and figure scripts that reproduce all results reported in the article "Aging-Aware Predictive Thermal Management of Lithium-Ion Battery Packs under Tropical Fast Charging and Uncertainty" (Engineering, Technology & Applied Science Research, manuscript no. 22085). The model is a reduced-order eight-cell electro-thermal-aging pack model that compares passive, proportional, predictive, and aging-aware robust predictive cooling under a tropical duty cycle, sensitivity runs, a heat-wave case, and 30 paired uncertainty scenarios.
